extracted.intended_audience: JPO examiners, patent attorneys, and applicants involved in PCT international search and preliminary examination
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for conducting and documenting PCT international searches and preliminary examinations at the Japan Patent Office, including substantive requirement criteria, examiner workflows, and preparation of PCT forms (ISRs, WO/ISA, IPER, WO/IPEA).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion from search/examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains judgement criteria for exclusion from search/examination in the international phase (listed in Chapter 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handbook states methods for treatment of the human or animal body by surgery or therapy, as well as diagnostic methods cannot be excluded from the subject of searches and examinations (§4.1.1). Note: such human treatment/diagnostic methods cannot be patented in the Japanese national phase, while animal methods may be patentable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Criterion of unity of invention to determine whether claims form a single general inventive concept (listed in Chapter 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handbook provides (1) summary of treaty/regulation provisions, (2) how to make a determination, and (3) differences between international and national practices with reference to Examination Guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior art
rubrics_metrics.description: Treatment and assessment of prior art in the international phase (Chapter 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes how to identify relevant prior art, categorize cited documents (see Appendix A), and indicate pertinent passages of cited patent family members (see implementation Measure (a-2)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of novelty (Chapter 4) as a substantive requirement in the international phase.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handbook explains treaty/regulation provisions, practical determination steps, and differences from national examination practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive step
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of inventive step (non-obviousness) in the international phase (Chapter 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance includes summary of relevant provisions, how examiners should determine inventive step, and reference to national Examination Guidelines where practices differ.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Criterion assessing whether an invention is susceptible of industrial application (Chapter 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes legal summary and practical examiner guidance on making determinations during the international phase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for description and claims (clarity, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive requirements for the specification and claims, including clarity and other formal/technical description requirements (Chapter 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handbook covers Treaty/Regulation summaries, how to judge sufficiency/clarity, and contrasts with national-phase examination practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment (treatment and effect)
rubrics_metrics.description: How to assess amendments to claims, description, and drawings during the international phase (Chapter 4; Appendix C).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appendix C explains how to decide the basis of the international preliminary examination where amendments have been made; Handbook gives stepwise determination guidance and examples of what to annex to IPER (see Appendix D).

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and determinations relating to priority claims in the international phase (Chapter 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarizes treaty/regulation provisions and examiner practices for assessing validity and effect of priority claims, and notes differences with national practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructions for preparing International Search Reports (ISRs) and WO/ISA forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical instructions for examiners on preparing ISRs and WO/ISA documentation (Chapter 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes examiner workflow during the international search stage, use of flow charts, and explanation of information entered in the boxes on PCT forms that are sent to applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructions for preparing WO/IPEA reports and International Preliminary Examination Reports (IPERs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on preparing WO/IPEA documents and IPERs during the international preliminary examination stage (Chapter 3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes examiner workflow for preliminary examination, formatting/content of WO/IPEA and IPER, and examples/annotations for examiner entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiners' workflow (international search stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes the typical workflow and tasks performed by examiners in the international search stage (Chapter 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flow charts and step-by-step illustrations are provided to explain examiner activities and decision points during the search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiners' workflow (international preliminary examination stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes the typical workflow and tasks performed by examiners in the international preliminary examination stage (Chapter 3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flow charts and stepwise instructions explain how examiners conduct preliminary examination and prepare associated documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information entered in PCT form boxes and communications to applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation of the information examiners should write in the boxes on PCT forms and how it is communicated to applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handbook gives examples and explains wording/format to ensure clarity and linkage between international-phase findings and applicant communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix A — Categories of Cited Documents (category codes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and use of category codes for cited documents (e.g., X, Y, A) used in ISRs and reports (Appendix A).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains meaning and application of each category code to help consistent categorization of prior art by examiners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix B — Manner for identification of cited documents
rubrics_metrics.description: How examiners should identify and cite documents in ISRs and other reports (Appendix B).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides format and examples for bibliographic identification and pinpointing relevant passages; includes instruction that when a cited patent document is in a non-English language and a family member exists in English, the examiner should mention that family member and indicate the corresponding part or passage (§B.1(1)(g)). An example showing JP/US/EP family members with column/line references is provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix C — Decision of the basis of the IPE where amendments made
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures to decide the basis of the international preliminary examination when claims, description, or drawings have been amended (Appendix C).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains case-by-case decision rules and how amendments affect the examiner's basis for opinion; includes structural guidance on documenting the decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix D — Case examples of annexes attached to the IPER
rubrics_metrics.description: Concrete case examples illustrating which amendments should be annexed to the International Preliminary Examination Report (IPER) (Appendix D).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides sample annexes and annotated examples to guide examiners on annex content and format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparation of invitations to pay additional fees (ISA/206, IPEA/405)
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for preparing official invitations for the applicant to pay additional fees during international work (Chapter 5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers form content, timing, and procedural handling for ISA/206 and IPEA/405 notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declarations of non-establishment of ISR (ISA/203)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on preparing and issuing ISA/203 declarations when an international search report is not established (Chapter 5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains permissible grounds, required wording/format, and downstream consequences for the international and national phases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrections and incorporation by reference
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and guidance for handling corrections to international applications and incorporation by reference (Chapter 5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains permissible corrections, formal requirements, and how incorporation by reference should be treated in international reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declarations as to exceptions to lack of novelty (Non-prejudice disclosure)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on declarations related to exceptions to lack of novelty, sometimes called non-prejudice disclosures (Chapter 5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains when such declarations are appropriate, required content, and effect on search/examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third party observations
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for receiving and treating third party observations in the international phase (Chapter 5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes how observations are to be filed, what content is acceptable, and how examiners should consider them in search/examination reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approach to explanations: three-part structure for substantive requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The Handbook's explanatory structure for each substantive requirement: (1) summary of Treaty/Regulation provisions, (2) how to make a determination, and (3) differences between international and national practices with reference to Examination Guidelines (Chapter 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This structure is the prescribed method for presenting each substantive criterion to ensure consistent legal grounding, practical examiner steps, and clarity on national/international differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promoting linkage between international and national phases — Identification of cited patent document and relevant parts (Measure (a-2))
rubrics_metrics.description: Measure encouraging examiners to identify an English family member and indicate corresponding parts/passages when the cited patent document is in a non-English language (Measure (a-2)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example provided: indicate JP and corresponding US/EP family member and specify column/line or page/line ranges so national-phase examiners/applicants can readily locate the relevant passages.
